description.narrative: ADAPT contribution is a new collaboration h with USAID’s Kosovo ADAPT Activity, aimed at enhancing climate resilience through the Climate Innovation Fund (CIF). This initiative seeks to facilitate the introduction of climate-smart technologies and mobilize up to 6 million USD in investments from private sector to promote innovative, sustainable, and green solutions and supporting Kosovo’s path toward greater resilience and making a meaningful contribution to climate adaptation efforts.

ADAPT-bidrag är ett nytt samarbete med USAID:s Kosovo ADAPT Activity, som syftar till att förbättra klimatmotståndskraften genom Climate Innovation Fund (CIF). Detta initiativ syftar till att underlätta införandet av klimatsmarta teknologier och mobilisera upp till 6 miljoner USD i investeringar från den privata sektorn för att främja innovativa, hållbara och gröna lösningar och stödja Kosovos väg mot större motståndskraft och ge ett meningsfullt bidrag till klimatanpassningsinsatser.

The USAID Kosovo Adapt Activity main objective is to support private sector, and research sector organizations in Kosovo to enhance adaptive capacity and resilience. Through collaboration, strategic communication efforts, and leveraging resources like the Climate Innovation Fund (CIF) with technical assistance, the proposed intervention seeks to strengthen Kosovo's ability to adapt to climate change and maintain a resilient inclusive economy. Specific expected outcomes the proposed intervention outlines specific measurable outcomes that are expected by the end of the intervention: Catalyze the introduction of at least 25 new technologies. Facilitate at least $6 million in investment for climate change adaptation and mitigation.
